controls.name: windowless native config-error gradient border
controls.before: VUID-vkCmdDraw-None-08600: native surface descriptor layout [80,160) remained bound while border pipeline required [80,208). First-error stack was native BorderPass draw, with no plugin loaded.
controls.fix: Always bind a per-draw immutable gradient UBO from the selected pipeline layout. Retain it in the command buffer until GPU-completed reuse.
controls.after: Same invalid-configuration reload renders successfully with zero core/synchronization validation errors.
controls.final_component_confirmation: Also exercised by final a921 minimal plugin custom-file unload/reload with zero validation errors.

controls.name: native sharp border with color management
controls.before: VUID-VkGraphicsPipelineCreateInfo-layout-10069: shader push constants [80,208) exceeded CPU range [80,176) when rounding was zero.
controls.fix: Border shader always requires geometry: always count/push SRounding for border draws; other shader families retain their conditional layout.
controls.after: Native sharp-border client and actual screenshot pass core/synchronization validation.

controls.name: native graceful device shutdown
controls.before: Device/instance destroyed before monitor, cursor, overlay, and command-buffer resources; validation reported live children.
controls.fix: Finish GPU work before scene destruction, release all monitor/cursor/overlay references before backend teardown, release device children before device/instance.
controls.after: Both native error-overlay and sharp-border controls exit normally with zero validation errors.
